scope: Source-level contracts, not runtime authorization or new theorem.

contracts.input_contract: Declared effective experiment and closure clouds, finite target alphabet, fresh row streams.
contracts.result: H constant on robust fibre permits high-probability honest finite certification; conflicting H gives the stated necessity bound.
contracts.limit: Not universal exact-target termination or arbitrary real-oracle access.

contracts.input_contract: Source-preserving finite representative, full joint feasibility and witness/proxy error bounds.
contracts.result: Certified finite approximation to target-law closure in both Hausdorff directions.
contracts.limit: Timeout/missing witness is not empty image; proxies need not be physical sources.

contracts.input_contract: One common initialization, source kernels and joint history; occurrence-level common mass.
contracts.result: Product retained mass bounds one joint readout TV error.
contracts.limit: Does not multiply marginal laws or grant shared error across separately executed programs.

contracts.input_contract: Actual correlated endpoint/bin law, legal cuts, offsets and same completion kernel.
contracts.result: Keep exact past; charge finite-prefix approximation only to suffix.
contracts.limit: Does not compute unknown past or prove empirical genealogy admission.

contracts.input_contract: Finite observed alphabet, calibrated full TV balls and wrong-property closed image.
contracts.result: Every-corruption certification requires strict distance greater than twice common radius.
contracts.limit: Equality obstructed; different contamination neighborhoods and sample complexity require separate analysis.

contracts.input_contract: Primary robust binary-testing model and contamination-dependent sample cost.
contracts.result: Relevant unresolved instability-scale and asymmetric-contamination questions in cited preprint.
contracts.limit: Unequal-radius overlap geometry and G6 honesty do not solve those cost questions.
